name: figma-to-tailwind-pro
description: Converta propriedades selecionadas no Figma em classes Tailwind CSS precisas.

scripts.lint: eslint src tests benchmarks scripts eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests benchmarks scripts docs README.md package.json manifest.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests benchmarks scripts docs README.md package.json manifest.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run security:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
